## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-6-ea14338c`

`crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs:227-248` adds `assert_o2_balanced`, but the check only proves `inventory_delta == sum(entry.net_mg())`; it never proves that the recorded oxygen `in_mg`/`out_mg` pairs are themselves correct. That is a real gap because snapshot-derived budgets still collapse oxygen to a single net delta (`crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:81-85`), and stage recording only debug-asserts net consistency (`crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:161-174`). The new regression at `crates/tank_core/tests/budget_helpers.rs:348-365` can therefore pass even if a stage regresses from correct gross O2 bookkeeping to a net-only or otherwise wrong gross split, which is exactly the class of bug this helper is supposed to guard against.

### `fr-6-4c95fd77`

`crates/tank_core/tests/budget_helpers.rs:109-126` tries to isolate `TANK_BUDGET_DEBUG` with a mutex, but the mutex only protects callers that also take that same lock. The smoke test at `crates/tank_core/tests/budget_helpers.rs:389-395` sets a process-global environment variable and then runs under Rust’s default parallel test harness, so unrelated tests in the same integration-test process can execute `step_and_inspect()` while debug mode is still enabled. When I ran `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_helpers -- --nocapture`, other tests emitted budget debug blocks while this guard was live. That makes the suite order-dependent and sets up future stderr/debug-path flakes.
